shots.focal_element: Large green circular checkmark badge centred on a flat lavender field, flanked by two diagonal clusters of small coloured dots
shots.what_happens: A lavender circle expands from a dark navy frame until it fills the screen (iris-style zoom through), revealing a green success checkmark; the checkmark stroke draws/settles while two groups of coloured dots drift outward and stretch into pill shapes like confetti, landing on 'get back to business as usual' (w273-w279).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a lavender circle mask from ~60% to 150% of the frame over a navy background, centre a 140px green circle with a white checkmark whose path draws on with ease-out, and animate two clusters of 4 coloured dots outward along a diagonal while stretching them on their motion axis.

shots.shot_type_other: illustrated_character_zoom_chain (flat vector illustration, infinite zoom through nested scenes)
shots.focal_element: A continuous centre-locked zoom through nested illustrated scenes: an eye, a meeting room monitor, a calendar/spreadsheet tunnel, an email compose window, a video-call grid and finally a woman's face
on_screen_text: Subject: Automation that drives you forward
shots.typography: Small UI-mimic labels in a light grotesk sans, sentence case, normal tracking, rendered as part of the illustrated email form; calendar cells carry small numerals (6-16) and a spreadsheet toolbar with column letters A-E, all incidental rather than read
shots.what_happens: Starting on an extreme close-up of a character's eye, the camera pushes into the pupil, which opens like an aperture onto a meeting room; it zooms into the room's wall monitor, through a nested calendar and spreadsheet tunnel, into an email compose window with typing hands, into a wall of video-call tiles, and ends on one participant's face, visualising 'unleash automation across your entire organization' (w285-w300).
shots.build_rebuild: Build each illustrated scene as a layer whose centre contains a scaled-down copy of the next scene, then animate a single continuous scale (exponential, ~8x per scene) on the root so the camera endlessly pushes through screen-within-screen frames, swapping the outer layer out once the inner one fills the viewport.

shots.focal_element: An 'Audit Log' card in the centre of a wall of pastel UI tiles, listing five Zap events with user avatars and timestamps
shots.transition_other: cut/zoom-out from the illustrated face onto a tilted wall of UI tiles that settles flat (not clearly visible between 2 fps frames)
on_screen_text: Zap Turned on by Quinn Fox
Zap Deleted by Nicky Steward 9:30 am
Zap Published by Quinn Fox 8:45 am
Zap Turned off by Quinn Fox 8:30 am
Zap Created by Riley Howard 8:00 am
shots.typography: Product-UI sans (grotesk, possibly Zapier's Degular/Inter-like face, low confidence); bold sentence-case card title 'Audit Log', regular-weight small row labels, mixed case names, normal tracking; the timestamp on the first row is partly hidden by the cursor
shots.what_happens: The camera settles on a mosaic of rounded pastel tiles separated by an orange gutter; the Audit Log card sits centre, and a large black cursor moves down the rows, each hovered row lifting and offsetting out of the card with a hard black drop shadow, as the voice-over says 'Use the audit log to maintain oversight' (w301-w313).
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out a CSS grid of rounded pastel tiles with an orange gap, place a centred card titled 'Audit Log' with five event rows, and animate a cursor that hops row to row while the hovered row translates up-left a few pixels and gains a solid 4px offset black shadow.

shots.focal_element: A 'Members' card with four users and role dropdowns, arriving at the centre of the tile wall
shots.transition_other: camera pan/slide across the same tile wall from the audit-log tile to the members tile
shots.typography: Same product-UI grotesk sans; bold sentence-case 'Members' title, small white-on-orange button label, medium-weight names over regular smaller email addresses, role labels in dropdown pills, normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The camera glides diagonally across the tile wall, passing a search/checklist tile and a step list with green checks, and settles on the Members card while the cursor drifts in from the right, on 'and assign super admin roles' (w314-w318).
shots.build_rebuild: Translate the whole tile-wall container diagonally with an ease-in-out tween over ~1s so the Members card (title, orange 'Add member' button, four avatar rows with role selects) lands centre-frame, with a static cursor parked to its right.

shots.focal_element: Role dropdown on Nicky Steward's row, opened to show Admin / Member / Super Admin options with descriptions
on_screen_text: Admin Can access all shared Zaps
Member Can access only Zaps shared with them
Super Admin Can access all Zaps (shared and private)
shots.typography: Product-UI grotesk sans at large scale due to the push-in; medium-weight option titles in sentence/title case with regular-weight grey descriptions beneath, highlighted option in dark blue text on a pale blue fill, normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes in on the Members card; the cursor clicks Nicky Steward's 'Admin' select, a dropdown opens beneath, and the highlight moves from Member to Super Admin as the voice-over says 'appoint trusted teammates to help maintain oversight' (w319-w328).
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the Members card from 1x to ~1.6x anchored near the third row, then on a cursor click fade/slide-down a 3-option dropdown with title + description lines and step a pale-blue highlight from 'Member' to 'Super Admin' as the cursor moves down.
